runs.label: Credit · original local gate

fixed_data_recipe.hypothesis: Retrospective outcome-aware credit can select more useful complete windows than local five-action assessment and can avoid indiscriminately copying a successful episode.
fixed_data_recipe.selection_before_results: One 100-update endpoint per branch, fixed before any branch evaluation. No best-checkpoint selection.
fixed_data_recipe.shared_conditions: Fresh identical original pi0.5, zero LoRA initialization, optimizer, seed and seven-channel flow loss in every branch. Uniform window sampling, 100 optimizer steps and ten autonomous development resets 20..29. All 426 source controls and original teacher tokens remain attributed, including the failed collection. Only hindsight carries the additional 83,532 retrospective-review tokens. No evaluation images reach the teacher.
fixed_data_recipe.interpretation: This screen changes only data selection relative to the other two branches. Its uniform sampling and 100 updates differ from the original online V5 learner, so it is not an exact rerun of that learning trajectory. The whole-success control explicitly labels binary episode success without asserting every copied command was locally useful. Development only; superiority requires fresh confirmation and repeated comparisons.

runs.task_instruction: put the wine bottle in the bowl

teacher.candidate_noise: common independent Gaussian draw, also used for the fixed native proposal
teacher.history: Previous real monitor images plus up to three collection-only failure summaries; evaluation outcomes are never sent to the teacher.
teacher.gripper_revision: Allow additive sign reversal for the gripper; target must still satisfy the unchanged [-1,1] controller bounds. Translation/rotation deltas stay <=0.5. No clipping of invalid teacher targets.
teacher.execution_contract: Only actions0–4 execute before observing and replanning. Targets are limited to these five steps. Candidate comparisons judge this prefix; unexecuted tails alone cannot establish harm. Training still needs complete ten-step windows built from actual consecutive execution.

pilot.scope: engineering and mechanism screening; not evidence of superiority over strong RL
pilot.threshold_rule: At least 8/10 successes at a scheduled checkpoint; report Wilson intervals and seed-level variation, not a win from one crossing.
pilot.learning_curve_x: all new collection control steps including failed and assisted actions; stabilization separately disclosed and included in total
pilot.evaluation_interactions: separate ledger; identical schedule and resets for every compared method
pilot.confirmation: Freeze recipe/tuning, then preregister fresh seeds and resets across all 20 tasks; no confirmation claim from pilot tasks.
pilot.evaluation_recording: Retain video, all executed commands/reset audits and the initial observation; skip redundant per-step evaluation NPZ files. Collection still retains every pre-action observation.

comparison_gates: Strictly load the SAME selected LeRobot checkpoint; never substitute RLinf's differently trained default checkpoint.
Verify normalization, tokenizer, camera orientation, horizon, velocity and native-action numerical parity after any checkpoint conversion.
Adapt the released OOD task/reset protocol and common action accounting to each baseline.
Equal development tuning budget, repeated seeds, same autonomous evaluation schedule.
Report threshold crossings as right-censored if not reached; no sample-efficiency win from assisted success alone.

compute.accounting: Sum allocated GPU task durations including bootstrap, failures and all compared methods; never exceed 24 GPU-hours.

revision_evidence.finding: On one archived observation, projected strength10 reduced target error 68.10% with RTC weighting versus 0.758% with t taper. Full gradient reduced 71.51% but substantially changed unmasked output components. This is not task-success evidence.
revision_evidence.v1_rollout_evidence: Astra rejected weak v1 lift candidates as ties; source and results are retained separately.
revision_evidence.unchanged: Checkpoint, real observations, controller bounds, resets and evaluation cadence; no FRS or extra demonstrations. V4 adds semantic candidates. V5 explicitly exposes the executed prefix and excludes padding from the supervised loss.
revision_evidence.v3_gripper: In v1 Goal6/reset0 at step175, Astra proposed three overlapping +0.5 gripper edits, correctly rejected by the cumulative limit; at step210 it explicitly declined intervention because +0.5 could not reverse the approximately -1 opening command. Widen only this channel to its full representable change. This prospective revision has no success-rate result yet.
revision_evidence.v4_semantics: In v2 Goal6/reset0, RTC lifts repeatedly occurred near the rack rather than transporting the bottle to the requested bowl. Frames at steps100/130/160/205 and recorded reviews show this. Add a semantic candidate family when the destination/subgoal is clear but a numeric world-coordinate correction is not. All candidates still need a clear predicted win against one fixed native proposal; only executed observed-useful commands train. This is a prospective alternative, not a success claim.
revision_evidence.v5_prefix: V2 reviews requested reassessment before steps6/8, and v3 comparisons cited failures in actions4–9 or6–9 even though only0–4 execute. Earlier requests exposed horizon10 but omitted the fixed five-action execution cutoff. V5 states the cutoff and forbids teacher targets on unexecuted steps. V1–V4 prompts/schemas remain unchanged.
revision_evidence.v5_loss: Audit of the pinned LeRobot PI05Policy.forward (lines1255–1257) and selected checkpoint output_features.action.shape=[7] found that v1–v4 averaged the 32-channel model loss, including padding. V5 matches the policy wrapper by supervising only the seven real action dimensions. The sampler and 32-dimensional noise/model interface stay unchanged; no SR benefit is claimed without evaluation.

libero_goal_ood:6:173.scope: Reuse the already-measured native baseline only if checkpoint, processors, deployment and reset hashes match; count no new interactions or independent evaluation replicate.

replayed_training_data.instruction: put the wine bottle in the bowl

teacher_decisions.scope: Retained parsed responses, including partial attempts. A requested intervention, predicted win, selected proposal, executed prefix and admitted training window are distinct counts.

interpretation: Local labels and whole-success imitation preserve the exact five native wins; hindsight loses reset28 and gains none. Selecting more windows or copying the complete successful episode did not improve autonomy under this fixed 100-update screen. One seed, one task, ten development resets; not proof that all hindsight credit or successful-episode learning fails.
